data.one_liner: Prebuilt UI components for text chat, media messaging, and voice/video calls.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-made UI components and screens for messaging, user and group management, and voice/video calling. Integrates with the CometChat backend SDK to handle chat functionality and real-time communication out of the box.
use_when: You want to add fully-featured chat and messaging to your Flutter app quickly
You need built-in voice and video calling screens tied to CometChat SDK
You want customizable chat components with support for theming and localization
avoid_when: You are building your own custom chat UI from scratch and only need raw backend API clients
You use a chat backend other than CometChat
strengths: Comprehensive UI components for conversations, messages, users, and groups
Built-in voice and video calling support via Calls SDK
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the proprietary CometChat backend and SDK
data.setup_notes: Requires creating an app in the CometChat Dashboard, obtaining App ID, Region, and Auth Key, and configuring SDK initialization.
